subject: FinApps POC kickstart — logistics & access
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@finapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: FinApps POC kickstart — logistics & access

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for the opportunity. Wed like to lock in the POC kickoff and hands-on session. Proposed high-level plan:

- Day 1 (kickoff + prompts walkthrough): 2.5 hrs (intro, goals, prompts, routing)
- Day 1 afternoon (hotseat prompt tuning): 1.5 hrs
- Day 2 (throughput/load validation): 60–90 min dedicated load window (we run controlled tests)

Proposed dates: May 18 or May 21 (we can be onsite or run hybrid). Can you confirm whether you prefer fully onsite for Day 1 or hybrid? If onsite, please send the visitor process and security contact so we can pre-register.

Two logistical asks:
- Confirm attendee list (names + roles)
- Any constraints on recording or screen sharing (some customers disable recordings for security)

Attached: finapps_poc_agenda_v1.pdf (draft).

Well also want a 30-min tech check before the session for A/V and the load test. Suggested backup: Zoom link and a short test run the day before.

Would either May 18 (10:00–13:30 PT) or May 21 (10:00–13:30 PT) work? Ill coordinate with Marissa and Ben for the runbook and load schedule.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai
[attachment: finapps_poc_agenda_v1.pdf]

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@finapps.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: poc@finapps.com, David Cho <david.cho@finapps.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FinApps POC kickstart — logistics & access

Mateo —

Thanks. Were excited to proceed. A couple notes from our side:
- Security prefers an onsite presence for Day 1 so they can observe data flows (theyre cautious about recordings).
- May 18 is difficult for many on our product team (company offsite). May 19 or May 21 would be better.
- For onsite visits: do you require any paperwork in advance (background check, liability forms)? We need to know badge/ID requirements and whether you can restrict recording.
- Please provide SOC2 evidence summary and KMS/encryption details for the test environment (David copied).

Can you confirm May 21 availability and the expected headcount from Redwood? Well follow up with an official attendee list and security contact details.

Jordan Ellis
Head of Integrations — FinApps
j.ellis@finapps.com
[poc@finapps.com]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@finapps.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 01:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinApps POC kickstart — logistics & access

Hi Jordan —

Quick answers from CS & security liaison side:
- SOC2: Attached is an excerpt that covers data handling + encryption at rest/in transit (SOC2_excerpt.pdf). For additional artifacts we can coordinate an NDA or signed evidence exchange (DocuSign link below).
- Visitor process: We can pre-register names for badges. Bring government ID; on-site staff escorts will be provided. Ill attach a short visitor_access_guidelines.pdf with timelines.
- Recording: We can disable recording and avoid uploading session media to cloud storage; we typically use ephemeral recordings only for internal QA unless customers opt out.
- On devices: we recommend using company laptops. If Redwood brings a laptop for the load test, we can provision network access in a restricted VLAN.

Links/attachments:
- https://drive.redwood.ai/finapps/soc2-excerpt (SOC2 excerpt)
- https://docusign.com/xyz-nda (NDA)
- visitor_access_guidelines.pdf (attached)

Ben and Lauren will own the load-test runbook and tech check. Ben: can you confirm the load window and whether we need to ship a test laptop?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
[attachment: visitor_access_guidelines.pdf]
[attachment: SOC2_excerpt.pdf]

From: David Cho <david.cho@finapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 10:10:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FinApps POC kickstart — logistics & access

Marissa, Mateo —

A few security clarifications from our team:
- We prefer no cloud-stored recordings of the sessions. Local, ephemeral recordings for troubleshooting are okay if deleted after 72 hours.
- On-site devices: vendor laptops are allowed but must run full-disk encryption and be pre-registered.
- Background checks: not mandatory for a one-day visit but we require names and DOB for badge issuance (will be handled by our concierge team).

Send the attendee list and encrypted laptop details to security@finapps.com and Ill review.

David Cho
Security Engineer — FinApps
david.cho@finapps.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@finapps.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinApps POC kickstart — logistics & access

Jordan —

Quick update: I have a scheduling conflict on May 18 (leadership offsite) and need to move the kickoff to May 21. Proposed schedule for May 21 (Pacific times):
- 10:00–12:30 — Kickoff + prompt review + routing decisions
- 13:15–14:45 — Hotseat prompt tuning + use-case validation
- 15:00–16:30 — Load/throughput validation (controlled tests)

Well respect the no-cloud-recording request. For the load test we can bring a pre-configured, encrypted laptop — Ben will provide the image details. Please send attendee names (full legal name + DOB for badge prereg) by EOD Monday so Marissa can register badges.

Attachments: final_checklist.pdf (pre-kickoff runbook).

Can you confirm May 21 and the tech-check slot? We can do a 20-minute AV/zoom test on May 20 at 16:00 ET.

Thanks,
Mateo
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
[attachment: final_checklist.pdf]

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@finapps.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: David Cho <david.cho@finapps.com>, poc@finapps.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: FinApps POC kickstart — logistics & access

Thanks team —

May 21 works. Well send the attendee list and DOBs for badge prereg by Wednesday COB. Security confirms encrypted vendor laptops are OK and they will disable recordings on their side; please ensure any Redwood-hosted recordings are not persisted.

We accept the May 20 tech check at 16:00 ET — please send the Zoom link. Also send the final runbook and the image details Ben referenced for our network team ahead of the visit.

Jordan Ellis
Head of Integrations — FinApps
[j.ellis@finapps.com]

Onward to a successful kickoff.
